//: Realtime Database rules — live bus positions only.
Everything else lives in Firestore (see firestore.rules). This database
exists because Firestore bills per document write, and a 3-hour route
publishing every 5 seconds is ~2,160 writes per bus per day.
Any signed-in user may watch a bus. The payload is a coordinate and
a speed — it does not identify any child. Restricting reads to just
the assigned families would need a per-bus roster mirrored into RTDB,
which is Phase 4 work if the pilot warrants it.
Writes are restricted to the driver currently assigned to the bus.
driverId is pinned to the writer's own uid so one driver cannot spoof
